english: routine
chinese: 日常
soundmark: /ruːˈtiːn/

english: My daily routine starts with a cup of coffee.
chinese: 我的日常从一杯咖啡开始。
soundmark: /maɪ ˈdeɪli ruːˈtiːn stɑːrts wɪð ə kʌp əv ˈkɒfi/

english: habit
chinese: 习惯
soundmark: /ˈhæbɪt/

english: It is hard to break a bad habit.
chinese: 改掉坏习惯很难。
soundmark: /ɪt ɪz hɑːrd tuː breɪk ə bæd ˈhæbɪt/

english: I have a very busy schedule today.
chinese: 我今天日程很满。
soundmark: /aɪ hæv ə ˈveri ˈbɪzi ˈʃedjuːl təˈdeɪ/

grammar.label: 主谓宾
grammar.text: 主语+谓语+定语+宾语+时间状语

english: time management
chinese: 时间管理
soundmark: /taɪm ˈmænɪdʒmənt/

english: Good time management is key to success.
chinese: 良好的时间管理是成功的关键。
soundmark: /ɡʊd taɪm ˈmænɪdʒmənt ɪz kiː tuː səkˈses/

english: leisure
chinese: 休闲
soundmark: /ˈleʒər/

english: How do you spend your leisure time?
chinese: 你怎么度过闲暇时间？
soundmark: /haʊ duː juː spend jɔːr ˈleʒər taɪm/

english: entertainment
chinese: 娱乐
soundmark: /ˌentərˈteɪnmənt/

english: Reading is my favorite form of entertainment.
chinese: 阅读是我最喜欢的娱乐方式。
soundmark: /ˈriːdɪŋ ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt fɔːrm əv ˌentərˈteɪnmənt/

english: hobby
chinese: 爱好
soundmark: /ˈhɒbi/

english: My hobby is collecting stamps.
chinese: 我的爱好是集邮。
soundmark: /maɪ ˈhɒbi ɪz kəˈlektɪŋ stæmps/

grammar.label: 主系表
grammar.text: 主语+is+动名词短语作表语

english: Work-life balance is important for well-being.
chinese: 工作与生活的平衡对幸福很重要。
soundmark: /wɜːrk laɪf ˈbæləns ɪz ɪmˈpɔːrtnt fɔːr wel ˈbiːɪŋ/

english: I prefer staying at home to going out on weekends.
chinese: 周末我宁愿待在家也不出去。
soundmark: /aɪ prɪˈfɜːr ˈsteɪɪŋ æt həʊm tuː ˈɡəʊɪŋ aʊt ɒn ˈwiːkendz/

grammar.label: prefer...to...
grammar.text: prefer doing A to doing B

english: The quality of life has improved greatly in recent years.
chinese: 近年来生活质量大大提高。
soundmark: /ðə ˈkwɒləti əv laɪf hæz ɪmˈpruːvd ˈɡreɪtli ɪn ˈriːsnt jɪəz/

grammar.label: 现在完成时
grammar.text: has+过去分词+副词+时间状语

english: A simple life is often a happy life.
chinese: 简单的生活往往是幸福的生活。
soundmark: /ə ˈsɪmpl laɪf ɪz ˈɒfən ə ˈhæpi laɪf/

english: We should learn to appreciate every moment of life.
chinese: 我们应该学会感恩生活的每一刻。
soundmark: /wiː ʃʊd lɜːrn tuː əˈpriːʃieɪt ˈevri ˈməʊmənt əv laɪf/

english: It is the simple things in life that matter most.
chinese: 生活中最简单的事才是最重要的。
soundmark: /ɪt ɪz ðə ˈsɪmpl θɪŋz ɪn laɪf ðæt ˈmætər məʊst/

english: Daily exercise keeps both body and mind healthy.
chinese: 每天锻炼让身心都健康。
soundmark: /ˈdeɪli ˈeksərsaɪz kiːps bəʊθ ˈbɒdi ænd maɪnd ˈhelθi/

grammar.label: 主谓宾宾补
grammar.text: 主语+keep+both A and B+宾补
